indicators.name: Arnaud Legoux MA
indicators.summary: Confirmed mismatch, with the data difference removed: on 143 days where the last 9 candles are identical on both charts, Nubra's ALMA differs from TradingView's ALMA on every day (average 372 points on MRF, up to 1,512). Cause: Nubra does not round down the centre position.
indicators.reasoning:
Redone on MRF daily candles, where Nubra and Fyers have identical candles (243 of 244 days compared; the only differences are 22 Sep missing on Nubra and today's 19 Nov candle). With identical closes, any ALMA difference must come from the formula.
Test: 143 days whose last 9 candles are identical on both charts (days near the missing 22 Sep and today excluded). ALMA(9, 0.85, 6, close) read from each chart's legend, then recomputed by me from the closes.
• Fyers = TradingView formula (centre m = floor(0.85 × 8) = 6): matches on 143 of 143 days, to the cent.
• Nubra = same formula without the floor (m = 6.8): matches on 143 of 143 days, to the cent.
• Nubra vs Fyers: equal on 0 of 143 days; mean difference 372 points, max 1,512 (MRF trades near 1.29 lakh, so about 0.3%).
Last six comparable days:
  day 18 Nov: close 128845 | Nubra 128470.49 | Fyers 128308.65 | TradingView formula 128308.65 | no-floor formula 128470.49
  day 18 Nov −1 bars: close 128840 | Nubra 128202.71 | Fyers 128013.65 | TradingView formula 128013.65 | no-floor formula 128202.71
  day 18 Nov −2 bars: close 128085 | Nubra 127858.65 | Fyers 127566.65 | TradingView formula 127566.65 | no-floor formula 127858.65
  day 18 Nov −3 bars: close 127955 | Nubra 127404.43 | Fyers 126960.60 | TradingView formula 126960.60 | no-floor formula 127404.43
  day 18 Nov −4 bars: close 128600 | Nubra 126724.98 | Fyers 126298.03 | TradingView formula 126298.03 | no-floor formula 126724.98
  day 18 Nov −5 bars: close 127125 | Nubra 125939.56 | Fyers 125579.08 | TradingView formula 125579.08 | no-floor formula 125939.56
What this means: with m = 6.8 the weights sit at fractional positions, shifting weight toward the most recent bar, so Nubra's line sits closer to price than TradingView's. Anyone comparing with TradingView or a broker's ALMA will see a different line.
Separate data notes (not the cause): MRF daily candle for 22 Sep 2026 is missing on Nubra; 19 Nov's candle differs (Nubra O 129000, C 129255; Fyers O 128750, C 129190); on NIFTY 5m for 19 Nov Nubra's closes were about 1.4 points higher than Fyers on 9 consecutive bars.

Formula to use to match TradingView one change: round the centre down
function alma(closes, offset = 0.85, sigma = 6) {   // closes: last N closes, oldest → newest
  const n = closes.length;
  const m = Math.floor(offset * (n - 1));          // ← TradingView rounds DOWN (Nubra today: no floor → 6.8)
  const s = n / sigma;
  let num = 0, den = 0;
  for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) {
    const w = Math.exp(-((i - m) ** 2) / (2 * s * s));
    num += closes[i] * w; den += w;
  }
  return num / den;
}
// test: alma([125295,126700,125105,127125,128600,127955,128085,128840,128845])  →  128308.65  (TradingView / Fyers)
//       without the floor the same closes give 128470.49  (what Nubra shows)
Evidence for the floor: Fyers (TradingView library) matches it on 143 of 143 days. Written from the standard definition; the floor is documented by StockSharp, while the unrounded variant exists too (e.g. Wickra). TradingView's own reference page and the original paper were not readable here, so the floor rests on Fyers' output.
